name: Image Gen (OpenAI)
description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 (or an OpenAI-compatible relay): text-to-image, image-to-image, masked edits, transparent backgrounds and custom sizes.
systemPrompt: Use image_gen_create to generate images with OpenAI's image API. Text-to-image: pass only prompt. Image-to-image / reference-guided editing: also pass reference_image_paths (local absolute file paths); add mask_path to limit the edit to a masked area. size takes 'auto' or WIDTHxHEIGHT (1024x1024, 1536x1024, 1024x1536, 2048x2048, 2560x1440, 3840x2160 …) and quality goes low → medium → high → xhigh → max; use low for quick drafts and high/max only for final assets, since quality and size drive cost and latency. Set background='transparent' (with png or webp) when the user needs a cut-out. For a long, high-quality single render, pass partial_images 1-3 so progress stays visible. Generated images are saved locally as absolute file paths in the tool result — use wechat_send or Session attach to show or share them afterward; do not re-download or re-encode them. If the tool reports the OpenAI API key is missing, tell the user to click the Image Gen settings button (gear icon) in the Composer toolbar and choose "OpenAI API Key" to paste it in directly — no need to hunt through Toolcase. The same settings button also sets the default model (gpt-image-2.5-sunburst for editing precision, gpt-image-2.5-flare for fast everyday generation), the default quality, and the "API Base URL" for a proxy/relay endpoint instead of api.openai.com (or pass base_url on a single image_gen_create call for a one-off override). When a request is blocked or rejected, the tool returns the API error code and a remediation hint — follow the hint instead of retrying the identical request.
tool.title: Generate Image (OpenAI)
tool.description:
Generate an image with OpenAI's GPT Image API, or edit/remix one using reference images and an optional mask.
- Text-to-image: pass only "prompt".
- Image-to-image (reference-guided generation/editing): also pass "reference_image_paths" with one or more local absolute image file paths; add "mask_path" to restrict the edit to a masked area.
- size takes "auto" or WIDTHxHEIGHT: 1024x1024 (square), 1536x1024 (landscape), 1024x1536 (portrait), 2048x2048, 2048x1152, 2560x1440, 3840x2160. Custom sizes need multiples of 16, an aspect ratio within 3:1, edges ≤3840px.
- quality: low (fast drafts) → medium → high → xhigh → max. Higher quality and larger sizes cost more and take longer, so start low and only raise it for final assets.
- background "transparent" (with output_format png/webp) gives a cut-out image; output_format png/jpeg/webp plus output_compression control the file.
- For a slow single render, partial_images 1-3 streams low-resolution previews so progress stays visible.
Generated images are saved to local files; the tool result returns their absolute paths. Use wechat_send or Session attach afterward to show/share the images — do not try to re-download or re-encode them yourself.
Requests go to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint configured via the Image Gen settings button in the Composer toolbar (default api.openai.com); pass base_url to override it for a single call only.
A failed call returns the API error code plus a remediation hint — change the prompt, size or inputs as instructed rather than retrying unchanged.

dialog.apiKey.desc: Paste your OpenAI API key. It is stored locally and only sent to the API endpoint used by Image Gen — never shown in chat.
dialog.model.desc: Used when a request does not name a model. Sunburst is tuned for editing precision, Flare for fast everyday generation.
dialog.quality.desc: Used when a request does not name a quality. auto lets the model decide; low is cheapest and fastest, max is the most detailed.
dialog.baseUrl.desc: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. a proxy/relay endpoint. Leave empty to use the official {default}.
dialog.invalidUrl.title: Invalid URL
dialog.invalidUrl.message: "{value}" is not a valid http(s) URL. The base URL was not changed.
result.fromPartial: The endpoint streamed previews but no final image, so the last preview was saved — it may be lower resolution than requested.
error.noKey: OpenAI API key is not configured. Ask the user to click the Image Gen settings button (gear icon) in the Composer toolbar → "OpenAI API Key" to enter it, then retry.
